name: Greater Noida–Agra Expressway

timeline.event: Project conceived as the Taj Expressway

history: The Yamuna Expressway connects Greater Noida with Agra along the Yamuna river, cutting the drive to the Taj Mahal to around two hours from Delhi. Built by Jaypee Infratech under a concession from the Uttar Pradesh government, it was one of India's earliest long access-controlled expressways and opened in August 2012. It now also serves the new Noida International Airport coming up at Jewar.
facts: Passes right by the Buddh International Circuit, which hosted India's Formula 1 Grand Prix.
Serves the under-construction Noida International Airport at Jewar.
One of the first fully access-controlled 6-lane expressways in India.
